key_insight: Aligning model attention with pathologists’ visual attention helps report-generation systems focus on diagnostically important prostate histopathology regions.
clinical_relevance: This could improve automated prostate cancer reporting and visual question answering by making outputs more accurate and better visually grounded for pathologists.
method: Collected a multimodal dataset of 121 prostate whole-slide images with synchronized viewport trajectories, verbal descriptions, and cursor movements.
Finetuned two report-generation models with an attention-alignment loss to match model patch attention to pathologist attention distributions.
Evaluated performance on prostate cancer report generation and visual question answering using models with different internal attention mechanisms.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports average gains of 10.9% on NLP-based metrics and 19.3% accuracy across five clinically relevant report components, with better alignment of inference-time attention maps to pathologist attention.
watch_item: The dataset is relatively small and specialized, so generalization beyond prostate histopathology and this annotation setup may require further validation.
paper_title: Pathologist Attention-Aligned Report Generation for Prostate Histopathology
